page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server type includes eight bundled NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps. However, it does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached storage options.

Given the high density of dedicated CPU cores and multiple hardware accelerators, this instance represents a high-tier hardware class designed for resource-intensive parallel processing. The qualitative cost profile reflects its specialized hardware configuration, balancing massive compute and GPU resources against the lack of local storage. It is designed for workloads such as GPU-accelerated machine learning, deep learning inference, data science jobs, and large-scale parallel computing tasks.
